title: Creamy Marry Me Pasta - Easy Vegan Dinner Recipe!
byline: Sam Turnbull @ It Doesn't Taste Like Chicken
ldKeywords: 30 minute meals, marry me pasta, pasta
ldIngredientsRaw: ½ cup raw cashews ((softened if needed, see step 1))
1 tablespoon olive oil ((sub water or broth for oil-free))
½ cup sun-dried tomatoes (drained if packed in oil, sliced)
½ cup fresh basil (chopped (plus more for garnish))
Optional for garnish: extra fresh basil, parsley, crushed red pepper flakes, a squeeze of lemon, or vegan parmesan
htmlIngredientLines: ▢ 12 oz pasta, any shape (gluten-free if preferred)
[cashew cream (or use 1 cup vegan heavy cream)]
▢ ½ cup raw cashews, (softened if needed, see step 1)
▢ 1 tablespoon olive oil, (sub water or broth for oil-free)
▢ ½ cup sun-dried tomatoes, drained if packed in oil, sliced
▢ ½ cup fresh basil, chopped (plus more for garnish)
▢ Optional for garnish: extra fresh basil, parsley, crushed red pepper flakes, a squeeze of lemon, or vegan parmesan
